notes.title: RELEASE OF THE GAME RUSSIAN VILLAGE SIMULATOR ON MARS!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!
Here comes that momentous day - the release of the game Russian Village Simulator on Mars, which we have been working on for more than a year!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800460
[previewyoutube=k6CAPMR35UQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We tried to fulfill almost all wishes of players from Russian Village Simulator.

We added the following to the release version:
1. New quests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/03c109e98dc1268ba7f52607c047f74e2028578d.jpg
2. New characters.
3. References to Russian folklore.
4. 33 new achievements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/3263c92ee38811abba9b4ba83cc6d5b1b26de0e8.jpg
5. Ability to pick up all types of fences.
6. Have broken down all quests by level so there is no confusion when completing them.
7. Corrected the translations into Russian.
8. Reduced the number of transportation in the quests.
9. Corrected the balance of prices.
10. Added more resources for crafting beds.
11. Added new cat scenes per level.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/6290f2cbe72056ea98fbf1b7a1924299e19cc10e.jpg
12. New animals to the village - cats and dogs and photographing them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44961983/534695737c04f321e3426abee8223b75dbb291f7.jpg
13. And other small changes.

We hope that you will like the game, because we put all our soul into it, read your comments and watched all the videos to make our game better!
We will further develop our project, as well as the first part of the game. It has quite a lot of potential!
We are waiting for your activity and your feedback, because the further development of the project depends on it!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS GAME RELEASE!
notes.content:
Here comes the long awaited day of releasing our game into early access!.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800460

[previewyoutube=k6CAPMR35UQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been working on this project for a whole year: we fixed various bugs, lags from the first part of the game and added almost everything that players asked for in the first part of the game.
The project is big and not everything has been realized and finalized yet. But even now it has already more than 100 quests, a system of construction, animal reproduction, voice acting, improved mini-map and large map, improved game mechanics and so on. List can be very long everything that has already been realized in the game.

Please note that the project is in early access and will be improved as possible. We want you to leave feedback and write feedback on the game in our community.
Thanks to you our project will become better!

notes.title: THE RELEASE OF THE SECOND MAJOR UPDATE, version 2.1!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!
We are releasing our second major update!

We have made the following changes and improvements to the game:
1. Added 13 new tasks. Some of them are quite difficult.
We also added a wedding quest: now you can marry Masha and have a wedding!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/e67eb910b4f96f1a72a2262530d7c78e02d8309c.png

2. Reduced the cost of the Ancestral nest to 900,000 rubles. Added more cash quests to make it easier to buy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/d8f8680586c8941c79f4ef820596fdb613741bb6.png

3. Fixed the disappearance of the "Save game" button. Previously, this button could disappear after exiting the transport.
4. Fixed the texture of the fishing rod.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/ff3a9cf7e97542f4b4a88b091b468fdb28d601e6.png

5. Added a personal horse after the barn was built. ːRussianVillageSimulator1ː
6. Removed the duplicates of Maxim's Grandfather, russianvillagesimulator2, but the quest "Water Carrier" now needs 100 liters of water instead of 50.
7. Added Julia's icon on the mini-map.
8. Added a zone of animals on Hunting grounds, displayed on a mini map and a large map.
9. Reduced the number of cans in the quest for the village chairman.
10. Now all pets will come out of their stall.
11. The fence of the chicken coop has been returned to its place.
12. Various errors in the Russian translation have been corrected.
13. Added the Spanish language.
14. We added a cut scene after completing a quest to find guitars.
15. Grandfather Maxim's brother now also shows a place where you can buy seeds. <- This all works only with a new game.
16. The NPC behavior system has been changed, as a small optimization.
17. Other minor fixes and improvements.
18. Added titles to the game after 1 year of development ːrussianvillagesimulator4ː

Our game will also participate in the Farming Festival, which will be held from April 29th to May 6th!

We would like to thank all the players: this week was exactly 1 year since the beginning of the development of the Russian Village Simulator. Throughout the year, we worked literally 24/7, improving this game, responding as much as possible to all users in the Steam community, VkPlay, Discord, and even in the comments on YouTube from most bloggers.

All this time, we have been adding various content to the game: new locations, new features, music, and so on, without adding all this to the DLC, without introducing micro transactions, since we want all the content to be available to players immediately after purchasing the game.

At the moment, we are developing a new project at our own expense and if you have the opportunity to support us in our endeavors, you will soon be able to purchase a Developer Support Pack as we continue to plan not to make paid DLC related to the content in our games.

We thank you very much for your support and kind words, and it is only thanks to you that we have been improving our game for a long time.

P.S. the next update for this game will be after 1000 reviews, as activity is important to us.
If you want to enjoy the rustic atmosphere, then we invite you to our next village-related project 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2800460/

We will try to implement the new project at the highest level. And we hope that you will support us in the next project, because there will be a lot of things that could not be implemented in the current project: multiplayer, construction, animal breeding and so on.

Thank you and good luck.

notes.title: Reduced the cost of the game for Latin America, Middle East, Africa
notes.content:
Greetings players!
Not so long ago Steam removed some local currencies in some countries, and instead of them introduced dollars and because of this the cost of our game in these countries has increased a lot.

Today we decided to reduce the cost of the game in a number of these countries, namely: Latin America countries - for users from Argentina, Belize, Bolivia, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guyana, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Suriname, Venezuela, Middle East and North Africa countries - for users from Algeria, Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Oman, Palestine, Sudan, Tunisia, Turkey, Yemen.

Previously the cost of the game for these countries was $7.99, from today $2.99..

Have a good game, and we are working on the big update!.

notes.title: SMALL PATCH 1.46
notes.content:
Welcome all players!

We have made the following minor changes to the game:
1. Now you can not use the map while in the car car. Previously, if you called the map, then shifted all the markers on the map, had to remove the map in the car.
And also you can not save while in the car.
2. When selecting the item "Save" in the menu now there will be no button "Load". Previously, because of this, you could accidentally load the game instead of saving. With the "Load" button in the menu did the same thing: now there is no "Save" button, so that you do not accidentally save the game instead of loading.
3. now Escape closes the training window.
4. FPS should become more stable. But here we need your tests, because we do not have the opportunity to test the game on all kinds of configurations. We test the game only on 3 computers with different configs.
5. Now tomatoes and cucumbers are weaker to restore hunger. And also reduced their cost.
6. Added French language.
7. Hungarian language has been updated.
8. Other minor fixes and improvements.

Continuing to work on a major update!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.44 - OPTIMIZING
notes.content:
Greetings players!
It's been a while since we've had an update and after some time we're releasing patch 1.44.

So, we have done the following work:
1. We have lightened the game on 1500000000 (1.5 billion triangles) making all models about 2 times lighter (some more and some less). And also reworked some of the textures, reducing their quality.
2. Build of the game now weighs 2gb less.
3. Added auto save after completing each task.
4. Fixed the sawing of firewood, now should work for everyone.
5. Day now lasts until 21:00, night is slower than it was before, but still faster than day.
6. At night, animals and people without quests from the map are now sent home.
7. Lights are now on in some windows.
8. Added the ability to switch shaders: SM6, SM5 and mobile shader. Previously, AMD graphics cards were experiencing graphical freezes. Switching to SM5 shader should fix this problem.
9. Now the ESC button closes interface elements. If somewhere suddenly does not close - write us.
10. Now you can open the map and the game menu while in transportation.
11. Now, if you sit in the transport, the benches disappear. When you get out of the car - they will reappear.
12. Under the wheels of transport now do not throw people and animals, except dogs, because dogs and in real life like to run after the transport.
13. Added additional icons on the map: school, store, hospital, metal depot, fire station.
14. Pork on sale is now cheaper.
15. Other small changes and improvements.

Some players encounter bugs when loading the game. the solution to some problems is in our community https://steamcommunity.com/app/2455370/discussions/0/7098294290812163229/.
If you can not solve the problem, you can now try to load the game from auto save.

To fully fix this error will have to rewrite the system of saving. That in turn will entail deleting all the saves of all players, which is not desirable. So we will not change the save system for now.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4: APIARY AND OPTIMIZATION
notes.content:
Greetings players!
This week we have been working very hard and as usual without a break.
We have made the following improvements and additions to the game:
1. Added apiary and honey itself. Hives need to be made on the workbench. Bees need to be fed and watered.
And about skill: now you need to have reputation to work at the workbench. It's different for each item.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/9399821fd0a7d9993dc493a2a1606278a1428abc.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/d29b5f10c02d1cc55d4d30af68482a0091f42d73.jpg


2. Added 6 new quests.
3. Removed camera shake, but if you are holding a gun, fishing rod, if you hit someone, jumping or working on a bed - camera wobble is present as before. But after these actions the camera will stop wobbling.
4. now for killing your animals does not remove reputation.
5. Also now reputation is added for completing all tasks. If for some task you suddenly did not get reputation - write us in the community.
6. Fish can now be taken out of the chest. There is no separate refrigerator for fish yet.
7. Fishing: now the rod is automatically cast a second time, after you have pulled out a fish. You cannot cancel a rod cast until the rod is cast.
8. Vehicles should now not crash into invisible collisions of NPCs and animals.
9. Eggs now appear in special crates, but can sometimes appear outside of them but nearby.
Eggs now do not appear if all chickens have been slaughtered.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/41c39c9b514dbccb55617612bc071cd08480de0b.jpg


10. Increased the card by 15%.
11. Added new areas: Hunting Grounds and Reserve and 2 new stops for them.
12. Added 2 modes to the game settings: quality and performance. This is the first stage of game optimization.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/8c81a60509524f4d37ca79c1534910c9d6043504.jpg


13. Fixed the quest with the priest, previously he still had the icon.
14. All berries have been replanted :-)
15. Animals are now not so quickly thirsty and hungry.
16. Chests are now removed from the map after opening and cannot be opened without lockpicks.
17. Other minor fixes and improvements.


And about the cost of the game: it is increased, as we said in the release news and in the last news.

Thank you for your activity. You are the best! 
Also we plan to organize a stream of answers to your questions. We will announce the date of this stream in the news. 


Some players want us to add co-op (multiplayer) to the game.
But to add it the game needs to have at least 1000 reviews so that we have the opportunity to implement it.
If everyone who bought the game left a review, there would be more than a thousand reviews :-)

notes.title: PLANS FOR VERSION 1.4
notes.content:
Greetings players!
We are actively working on version 1.4, in which we plan to add a lot of functionality and fix some bugs and balance of the game, for example, there will be an apiary, new tasks, improved performance and so on.

Version 1.4 we plan to release on Friday this week.

Please write about all the bugs you have found either in the comments to this news or in our community.

You can also write your ideas and suggestions in the game community. We try to listen to you :-)

Attention: some players want us to add co-op (multiplayer) to the game.
But in order to add it to the game we need to have at least 1000 reviews so that we can realize it.
If everyone who bought the game would leave a review of the game - there would be already more than a thousand reviews :-)

We remind you that with the release of version 1.4 the price of the game will be increased to $14.99. The regional price tag will remain, i.e. not everywhere the game will cost the same.

notes.title: PATCH 1.3 and about multiplayer
notes.content:
Greetings players!
We are releasing another patch with the following changes:
1. changed the water of the lakes, see screenshot below. Now the water is not like in the Maldives :-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/fda4f755d4f80eb0e3f86fa5909844b24a4c30fa.jpg

2. Quests can now be filtered by status in the quest menu. By default, the quests you have taken are displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/3a70f26285258dfa8a2f29db7cd321ec3a0556a1.jpg

3. Added chests in which you can store any items from your inventory.
You can put not all items in the chests, but you can specify the number of items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/984e3c868de0da4725263a5fde45e01d6fb0b6c9.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/e73da876af908f9bfe6a699d2c50461291fbc2f5.jpg

4. Similarly with the food fridge and the berry fridge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/e0e413c78cb14d01ab913742db77ae8cf76f4ee0.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/4628e916cc73e262b0ddf5c50d946de7d2eaa2bc.jpg

5. Also in the store, you can now specify the amount sold and the amount bought.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/eb82f5e7a83c9c7dd58726ca00059ba2f2bdfacb.jpg

6. The Zhiguli five is now not accelerating so sharply. But the tractor was added speed.
7. Changed a little system of animal behavior.
8. Forest animals are now not so quickly removed from the map after you left the place of their habitat.
9. Added about 7 roads.
10. Reduced a little range of drawing trees.
11. Now the character gets off the horse more correctly.
12. Sazan renamed to Yazya.
13. Fixed the recipe with catfish.
14. If you had a gun in your hands and you get into an auto or on a horse - the gun did not disappear, now it does.
15. Fixed achievements related to transportation.
16. The cross to close is now red and better visible.

Attention: some players want us to add co-op (multiplayer) to the game.
But to add it the game needs to have at least 1000 reviews, so that we have the opportunity to implement it.
If everyone who bought the game would leave a review of the game - there would be already more than a thousand reviews :-)

notes.title: PATCH 1.2 + music DLC
notes.content:
Greetings players!
Releasing a small patch that fixes the following:
1. Quest with elections where you need to give 50000 rubles fixed.
2. Spavn forest animals fixed: now there will not be large clusters of animals.
3. TV is correctly turned off.
4. To the Hungarian translation added the remaining 8% of the translation.
5. We are also releasing music DLC https://store.steampowered.com/app/2619590.
If you want to additionally support us and the musician, you can purchase it with a 20% discount.

notes.title: PATCH 1.1 + Hungarian language
notes.content:
Hello players!
We are releasing a small patch with the following changes:
1. Simplified some of the textures of the game. Due to this, the final build became lighter by exactly 4GB.
2. Added Hungarian language.
On localization: the game is 100% translated into English and Russian.
Hungarian: 92%;
Italian: 80%;
Portuguese: 79%.
If you want to help with localization of the game, all information is available at https://github.com/vitagame/RussianVillageSimulator (localization files have been updated).
3. Corrected the exit from the transport, previously if the player got out of the car, being on an uneven surface, he could not go into the doorway.
4. Fixed some achievements.

We continue to further work on the game.

A big request to players: please write reviews.
Thank you for it.

notes.title: Russian Village SIMULATOR game release!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
Here comes that long-awaited day - the day of release of our game "Russian Village Simulator".

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455370

[previewyoutube=NOPMOujF9XI;full][/previewyoutube]

It's been 15 days since the release of the major update. During this time we have added a lot of interesting things to the game, namely:
1. Added 19 new quests and new NPCs.
2. Added the ability to fish in lakes and 5 types of fish.
You will need to buy a rod from a fisherman near the lake.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/91c6766dfbb581f45b3ef4b86630f7294a6397af.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/ce4572524cc81119721cb42d1c4575bba3248c31.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/a46bfce5a08cb29f0df8b515a3b49cf81f2b3af2.jpg

3. Added new locations: "At the Fortune Teller's". "Railroad station" (with its own quest), "Kindergarten" with quests from Julia.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/e6a40d567805dd07a2490c417366ce310997343e.jpg

4. Added 11 new recipes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/540c2c142d794ad9aa82de2948daad94a7a95380.jpg

5. Added the ability to buy geese.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/1f1747d85bfa92272fcdfd7e186c44ab7705b70f.jpg

6. Improved sawing of timbers: now you don't have to saw timbers one by one, but can specify the number of timbers at once.
7. After completing quests from NPCs, these NPCs will be doing their own things, not just walking around the village.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/19f7845cf8aa72c670a3b2219820e39e20c7b3f2.jpg

8. The game has Photo Mode, you can run it on the P button and take beautiful screenshots.
9. Added more Buchanoks.
10. Added two granny vendors at the "Theme Park" location.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/d60e131ac08e83e4f54bbc07e8fdaff7299cee18.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/884cb50410b630e9eb4eb71a619f6d02eb95bc21.jpg

11. Some of the items have had their balance changed.
12. Animals now cost more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/25a59862128a6279eaf45eea96afac9be38232ca.jpg

13. Added the ability to grow beets.
14. Added 17 achievements.
15. Added an extra clip on TV.
16. Added 11 new tracks. Now there are 32 of them in the game. All tracks are written from scratch specifically for our game.
16. Fixed the clothes of some NPCs.
17. If you linger in the menu, you will be waiting for various animated references.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/2474750b2fed1900e751b8c9e8376141f4530e71.jpg

18. And other minor changes and improvements.

We still have a lot of different improvements and updates in the plans. But the fate of the game depends solely on the activity of players.

For those who started the game in early access we recommend starting the game over to avoid the problems that were in the old patches.

Please note: the price of the game a week after the release will be increased as a lot of new content has been added to the game. Hurry up and buy the game!.

notes.title: PATCH 0.47 + Portuguese localization
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
Introduced minor changes to the game, but the patch came out weighing 3.3gb.

1. Added to the game Portuguese language, thanks for the translation user https://github.com/osnipezzini.

2. Now when loading the game try to delete duplicate characters and animals. But sometimes a couple can still remain :-)
3. If you have taken quests from characters that were duplicates, you can cancel them by going to the quest itself.
4. Added a sign asking for feedback in 4 languages. We would really appreciate it if you would write reviews about the game (any kind). Thank you for this.

Further work on improving our game "Russian Village Simulator" and listen to your ideas and suggestions..

notes.title: PATCH 0.46 + Italian localization + chopping trees
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
Releasing a fresh small patch:
1. Added Italian localization, thanks to the user https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198255362712 for translating the game into Italian.
2. Now the eggs at the hens spavnyaetsya after a certain time, previously they appeared and just fell under the landscape.
3. Added the ability to cut down trees with an axe. But you can not cut down those trees on which you can hang feeders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/90f670d247ff064f13d7b60d5f2dae14de6a1747.jpg

4. Now you can use a tractor to deliver hay and Bukhanka to deliver parcels to the villagers.
5. Other minor corrections and improvements.

notes.title: HUGE PATCH, game version 0.45
notes.content:
Greetings players!
We have done quite a lot of work recently, adding a variety of new functionality, as well as fixing some old bugs, namely:

1. Changed the lighting in the game, making the game a bit brighter.
2. Replaced the grass. In our opinion, it is more combined with the locations. Thinned out the location from the trees, now they are a little less.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/62f23eadb76a29f9c1c636594e36d0dcb30185a7.jpg

3- Changed the balance of all foods: now cooked foods are more hunger-quenching than say berries.
4. Added transportation: tractor, ZIL-130, ZIL-131, ZIL-130 fire truck, UAZ-452 (Bukhanka, at the moment its purchase is not available, but later we will add the ability to buy from a mechanic, like Zhiguli five) and UAZ-452 for the postal service.
On the part of the cars you can perform various tasks, for which money and reputation are credited.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/7ed046780f611ac65d7be5492f216dc80327d491.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/81725acc237d180d5aaa91a847e6618b20616a2d.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/5870302ee0cf0928d8188d55f360f040d6251d5d.jpg

5. Added horse. At the moment it is on Grigory's farm. Later it will be available for purchase from Farmer Grigory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/919f25b6493a7d285b5fce7315067069740d1104.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/bbb8cdae5f57c199bd05e68bac6cc53175536eac.jpg

6. Added new locations: metal depot, kindergarten, hospital, fire station, theme park.
7. Icons on the mini map are now correctly displayed.
8. Purchased animals are now correctly added and made a limit on their number: all animals except chickens can be added no more than one, chickens can be added 3.
9. Animals are now correctly fed and automatically appear if feed and water are added to the feeders. If food or water is not added, you will be notified when the animal wants to eat or drink.
10. Some of the icons have been replaced.
11. Removed the display of rocks on the mini map.
12. Added the ability to mine humus. Humus is needed to create greenhouses, which you will have after the construction of the barn.
13. Replaced the oven, it also needs to be created and at this point you can bake a loaf. Perhaps later we will add more recipes for the oven.
14. Now in the player's hut there is a TV with a chair, which you can watch. In the TV added so far 2 videos. TV is launched by clicking on the chair :-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/0dd49c8ba289af2dcfc7780ff9ca3a9c35de78e5.jpg

15. There is an old tape recorder in the bed, when you click on it you can play a fun track.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/98dad82dc16962dd79d54627274b94906a0f20c8.jpg

16. The radio in the house also runs one track, a remix.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/e0603476e4ff7ec69e8cd2d2a73e6d926a055ec7.jpg

17. The supplied benches can now be sat on. The benches partially relieve fatigue.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/0050c974f3b0099fac82cf608741fcd777c64076.jpg

18. Added 11 unique music tracks to the existing 10 tracks.
19. Birdhouses on trees are now only displayed when approached.
20. Green material in items is now less flashy.
21. When clicking the "Continue" button, you can now select a save slot.
22. Improved game optimization..
23. Updated the quick access menu, some players were uncomfortable using the old version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/8d58c7856c472cea2b5fea910554a8b7d2ade5d0.png

24. Other minor and not so minor changes and improvements.

For a more correct game play we recommend to start the game again as elements of the old mechanics may have been preserved.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/f0b36e05cd5d0a8fec22ff4d3e4a01dfb5b5a774.jpg

We'd like to give a special thanks to the hundreds of people who made a return of an early access game that cost far less than any game of a similar level on Steam.

But what motivates us are those players who leave reviews about the game and share their impressions..

We continue to plan to improve the game, add new quests, fix bugs/flaws and much more. 
Thank you for being with us..

notes.title: Working on the release version, #3 - Horseback riding, fire station and so on
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We haven't had any news from us for a few days, and that's simply because we're working on the game's functionality literally non-stop!

We have added the ability to ride a horse on horseback (the horse has stamina and you can't gallop for a long time):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/6cc47bc9c0c81f3b785e02711040e70455a92446.jpg

Horses will be available to buy from farmer Gregory.


Added a fire station with a fire engine ZIL-131. On this car you can perform tasks to extinguish various fires. For extinguishing fires we will receive money and increase their reputation. The more fires extinguished - the more and the award.
But if you get out of the car - the multiplier award resets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/8f7e948e2b787be1928ba5e621f628490e70eb30.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/f0b4bc5645fccea9d172a9ed744a481b4febbaee.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/4fc7837e576375b9948974874420fffaaffd82ec.png

And also worked on optimization.

We hope for your support and your feedback! 
Thank you.

notes.title: DAY FOUR PATCH
DAY THREE PATCH
SECOND DAY PATCH
First day patch and an appeal to players!
Russian Village Simulator development diary #1
notes.content:
Greetings to all visitors to the site.
During the development of the game has been added quite a lot of new functionality.
The game map is also being worked on.

And thank you for 2000+ vishlists during these 27 days. We hope you won't be disappointed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/04f8ff0f6e5a7a69c40bfb156be388cefd056aa0.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455370/

Previously, we wrote that the interface of the game is similar to the interface of the mobile game. We've redesigned it a bit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/3708895ccdb74b34a0153da351d0696851279867.jpg

Added top menu: inventory, quests, training log. Also when opening a tab like this, a little blurring of the background.

Added functionality for quests or quests. In addition to the usual simulation (planting a garden, picking berries, mushrooms, dead wood, and so on) on the map will be people who will give various tasks. These tasks are, in turn, recorded in the assignment log. If you took the task by mistake or do not want to perform it, you can refuse it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/816ed71b4a2ed93b4048293909d9d6680c74a681.jpg

А также появился функционал мини-карты, реализованный без каких-либо плагинов, с нуля. На данной мини-карте будут отображаться различные задания и активности.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/5488ebb30f0e851d50afed2b43f7adc5f6dffac5.jpg

А вот так примерно выглядит функционал пиления брёвен в доски. С которых в свою очередь можно создавать скворечники и вешать их по деревьям.

[previewyoutube=NHs_K_9oxvc;full][/previewyoutube]
Вообще за различные положительные дела будем давать очки репутации, которую только начали вводить в игру.

Функционал добычи камня киркой. Некоторым не понравился :-) Но мы так решили.
[previewyoutube=haQP03lNxYQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Подберёзовки добавлены под березы автоматически.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/76f84ab84387d6c76941bf860764443f833d5889.jpg

I wrote a small blueprint, which places various small objects on the map: mushrooms, birdhouses, logs, berries (3 types). This simplifies their addition and accelerates the elaboration of the map.

Backlighting of objects with which you can interact, made orange, for the past, the white was quite poorly visible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/f0cc61ba19bd13b86b0374dd42097c45643d71fc.jpg

Added a double-barreled shotgun to go hunting with. And added for now bears that can maul us in the woods. Ammo for the double-barrel will most likely be available from the forester.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/3505c2ef4f10b7dc61e43a91d0ba52f2b418cc90.jpg

What about optimization?

Work has also been done on optimizing the game and its assets. The quality of the same textures have been reduced, lods have been adjusted, the range of drawing of vegetation, trees and other objects. Standard Cull Distance Volume game engine Unreal Engine 5 on the map is not yet put and configured. But perhaps it will be added.
Landscape material was transferred to the Runtime Virtual Texture (RVT), which gave some boost in FPS and got rid of freezes, which are sometimes manifested.

Also have been finalized materials biboard tree logs. Specular, Roughness, Metalic, Normal were set to 0. The default engine seems to be 0.5, which also eats up some resources.

World Partition was decided to abandon it, because of its inadequacy in terms of performance.

Somehow it looks like this on a 3060 with Ryzen 7 processor in FULL HD without DLSS.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/1a5157578e7e4feabd21fa486151af0f9b3c28e7.jpg

In 4k it's about 38 FPS. That said, the monitor is FULL HD and the graphics card had to scale the picture. Hopefully on an honest 4k monitor the FPS will be higher :-)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/db1c760210230422b93f8211218ed5a208e89f89.jpg

Also, we added to the game museum, which presents pictures of the original village, which was taken as the basis and pictures of one of the cities of the developer.

True, the developer's computer has another 128GB of RAM, but we do not think that its number significantly affect the FPS for the game eats about 4-5GB of memory. But the simpler the processor - the memory burn more.

Also added to the game museum, which shows pictures of the original village, which was taken as the basis and pictures of one of the cities of the developer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44190760/afaa24365fa3ef59499db251784ba22dee95ce57.jpg

Probably haven't written about any of the functionality in the game yet, but we will in another post.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455370/

Don't forget to add the game to your Wishlists!
